scripts.test:sdk: PATH="$(dirname "${RUBY_BIN:-/opt/homebrew/opt/ruby@3.4/bin/ruby}"):$PATH" sh -c 'bundle install --quiet && bundle exec rake test'
scripts.lint: PATH="$(dirname "${RUBY_BIN:-/opt/homebrew/opt/ruby@3.4/bin/ruby}"):$PATH" sh -c 'for file in lib/*.rb lib/flagbearer/*.rb test/*.rb ../testing/servers/ruby-server.rb; do ruby -wc "$file" >/dev/null || exit 1; done'
